changelog: Setup now ends by telling you to open a fresh session and whether a note is waiting, the Send box says it is the confirmation, and your agent offers a note back when an answer changed your work.
features: Setup ends with: open a fresh Claude Code session to load /vibe; sessions already open will not see it
If a note is already waiting when you finish setup, it says so and from whom (people you know by name; never the message text)
The Send box's first line now reads Confirm: send to @name?, so it reads as the confirmation of the send you just asked for
When someone's answer changed what you did, your agent offers a one-line note back as a draft; it goes only if you choose
That offer now also works for answers you first saw at the start of a session
